text: A POWERFUL AND IMPORTANT MORNING WITH INDEPENDENCE HOUSE![image][image]Such a great and important morning at the annual Domestic Violence Awareness Breakfast at Margaritaville Resort in Hyannis.[image][image]While I couldn’t stay for the entire event, I was so impressed by the information, the displays, and the important message being shared.[image][image]The “Lightkeeper” concept was especially powerful. It reminds us to look beyond what we see and pay attention to what others may be experiencing behind closed doors. The interactive displays showed different forms of abuse, including financial abuse, technology-facilitated abuse, coercive control, and the impact of abuse on work and businesses.[image][image]Be a lightkeeper who notices what others may not see.[image][image]It was also heartbreaking to see the display honoring the Massachusetts victims of domestic violence who have lost their lives in 2026. Every name represents a life, a family, and a tragedy that reminds us why awareness, education, and action matter so much.[image][image]As a former police officer and domestic violence specialist who has put batterers behind bars and stood up for women and survivors, this morning really hit home.[image][image]Please take a few minutes to look through the pictures and learn more about the many forms domestic violence can take. Sometimes, recognizing the signs and speaking up can make all the difference.[image][image]IF YOU OR SOMEONE YOU KNOW NEEDS HELP:[image][image]Independence House 24-hour hotline: 800-439-6507[image][image]If you are in immediate danger, call 911. Law Enforcement Officers will be on the way.[image][image]I’m always proud to see Lysetta Putnam, Executive Director, and her incredible team continuing this important work. I’m also proud to have served on the Independence House Board of Directors and to continue as an ambassador supporting their mission.[image][image]Keep up the great work, Independence House! I look forward to seeing everyone next week at the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the new building.[image][image]Let’s keep looking out for one another, raising awareness, and being the light someone may desperately need.[image][image]God bless! CONGRATULATIONS, HEIDI AND DAVE![image][image]What a GREAT morning in the great town of Sandwich, right here in the heart of the Fightin’ Fifth![image][image]Senator Dylan Fernandes and I had the pleasure of surprising everyone with citations from the Massachusetts House of Representatives and State Senate![image][image]We recognized Heidi Trottier, Director of the Sandwich Chamber of Commerce, for an outstanding year, all her hard work, and the many accomplishments she and her team have achieved. From growing membership to always being there for local businesses and the community, Heidi gives it her all, 24/7![image][image]We also presented Dave Sampson with a citation recognizing his years of service to the Sandwich Chamber as he wrapped up his time there. Dave continues to serve the town as a member and Chair of the Select Board, and we are grateful for everything he does for Sandwich![image][image]Great people, a great building, and a great morning celebrating two people who give so much back to their community.[image][image]Keep up all the great work, Heidi and Dave, and thank you to everyone at the Sandwich Chamber of Commerce for all you do for our businesses and the town of Sandwich.[image]🇺🇸😊👏🏻[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #CommonSenseLeadership #Barnstable #Sandwich #Bourne #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]Sandwich Chamber of Commerce[image]Town of Sandwich, MA[image]Sandwich Council on Aging[image]Dylan Fernandes

TODAY, WE STAND TOGETHER AGAINST DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.[image][image]I’m here at the annual Independence House Domestic Violence Awareness Breakfast at Margaritaville in Hyannis. This is an incredibly informative and interactive event that reminds us how abuse can happen in many different ways and how, if left unchecked, it can tragically lead to death.[image][image]Please take a moment to look at these displays, learn the warning signs, and remember that help is available.[image][image]If you or someone you know needs help, please reach out. You are not alone, and we are here to help.[image][image]Thank you to Independence House for the important work you do every single day.[image][image]God bless. TONIGHT IN SANDWICH! [image][image]Join us tonight from 5:30–7:30 PM at the Sandwich Center for Active Living for an important community event recognizing Substance Use Prevention Month.[image][image]Learn about prevention, connect with local resources, hear from keynote speaker Kevin Rosario, and explore the Hidden in Plain Sight trailer to help parents recognize potential warning signs.[image][image]There will be activities for kids and teens, pizza, and refreshments![image][image]Continuing to together to educate, prevent, and protect our kids. Please share and spread the word![image][image]Hope to see you!
